description: Move an order to a stage of the workspace's own order pipeline, the board the team tracks work on. The stage is a label: payment, fulfillment and stock do not change. Moving to the stage the order is already in is a no-op; an unknown stageId is refused. Valid stage ids come from get_order_pipeline. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.
name: set_order_pipeline_stage
title: Set order pipeline stage
